title: Blood oozing from nose, UP cop found dead inside car
description: A sub-inspector was found dead inside his locked car in Para on Friday.  He had been out of contact with colleagues since Thursday afternoon.  Police traced his mobile phone to the Budheshwar-Mohan road location.  Doctors declared him dead after he was shifted to a hospital.  Forensic examination and post-mortem will establish the exact cause of death.

title: After Andhra, Covid-19 resurfaces in Maharashtra after 3 years
description: Maharashtra has seen a rise in Covid-19 cases, mostly mild, over recent days.  Experts note the virus now follows influenza-like patterns with periodic spikes.  Most positive cases were detected during physician-advised investigations or pre-operative assessments.  This recent uptick is the first noticeable increase in Covid cases since around 2023.  Hospitals are also observing increased cases of influenza and other infections.

title: 46 yrs after SLV-3, Skyroot’s Vikram-1 set to mark new chapter in private space journey
description: Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1, India's first private orbital rocket, is scheduled for launch. This launch occurs 46 years after ISRO's SLV-3 mission from Sriharikota. The Vikram-1 rocket is 22 meters tall and built with advanced composite structures. This maiden orbital test flight aims to gather crucial flight data for future development. The mission marks a significant milestone for India's burgeoning private space sector.

title: Lamine Yamal separated from Spain squad ahead of final against Argentina
description: Spain have eased concerns over Lamine Yamal's fitness after the teenager trained separately ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup final against Argentina. The RFEF and coach Luis de la Fuente insist the session was precautionary, with Pedro Porro also on an individual programme. Both players are expected to be fit as Spain chase a fourth World Cup title on Sunday.

title: Shatrughan Sinha backs Sonakshi Sinha for supporting Sonam Wangchuk, his team thanks her
description: Veteran actor and politician Shatrughan Sinha has publicly praised daughter Sonakshi Sinha for speaking in support of activist Sonam Wangchuk, who has been on an indefinite hunger strike at Delhi's Jantar Mantar over the alleged NEET-UG paper leak issue. Following the support from Sonakshi Sinha and actor Omi Vaidya, Sonam Wangchuk's team responded on behalf of the activist, expressing gratitude for their solidarity.

title: 'Tie nuptial knot to her body': How techie's suicide case turned into demand for posthumous marriage
description: Tension arose in Ponduru village after a woman's family brought her body to her boyfriend's residence. They demanded he marry her corpse before her final rites could be performed. The woman, Keerthi, died by suicide after her boyfriend reportedly refused to marry her. Her family claimed this was her dying wish before her cremation. The family eventually conducted the cremation after Sai's family agreed to the rites.

Microplastics reach remote ecosystem as Indian Ocean animals show high levels
description: Microplastics have infiltrated remote deep-sea hydrothermal vent ecosystems globally. A recent study found microplastics in ninety-two percent of examined deep-sea animals. Polystyrene was the most frequently detected polymer among the plastic particles found. Feeding behavior influenced microplastic accumulation within the animals' bodies. Animals from the Indian Ocean showed significantly higher microplastic concentrations than Pacific specimens.
